description: Turns a stereo pair into a mid and a side signal, each with its own gain

params.text: Sets the level of the mid output, from silence to twice
Sets the level of the side output, from silence to twice

inputs.text: The left side of the stereo pair
The right side of the stereo pair

outputs.text: The two inputs added together, times the MID GAIN knob
The right input subtracted from the left, times the SIDE GAIN knob

notes: the sum and the difference are taken without halving, so two 5V inputs give 10V at the mid output; the gain knobs are the only place to take that back.
feeding the same signal to both inputs gives silence at the side output, which is the check that the encoding is working.
